title: Sharks vs Trees
hook: You think trees came first, right?
script: You think trees came first, right? But sharks have been here for over 400 million years. They swam in oceans before trees existed. The first trees didn't appear until tens of millions of years later. Sharks were already ancient by then. They predated the first forests. Their history is longer than that of trees. Tag someone who won't believe this. Save this so you remember it, and think about it next time you see a shark or a tree.
